object.name: session_manager
object.description: Privileged interface for registering owned sessions. Only accessible to root clients.

c2s.name: create_session

description.summary: start registering a new session, returning an owning session object

c2s.description: The leader PID and optional fields may be staged before commit finalizes the configuration and creates the session.

object.name: session_management_session

description.summary: owning handle for a session created via create_session

object.description: The leader PID and optional fields may be sent while the session is staged. Setting remote_host marks the session as remote. Once the session has been committed, modifying staged fields or committing it again is a protocol error. Destroying this object tears down the session and its resources.

c2s.name: vt
c2s.description: Optional. Must be sent while staged. Defaults to 0 (not bound to a VT).

c2s.name: remote_host

description.summary: stage the remote host and mark the session as remote

c2s.description: Optional. Must be sent while staged.

c2s.name: class
c2s.description: Optional. Must be sent while staged. Defaults to user.

c2s.name: env
c2s.description: Optional. Must be sent while staged. May be sent multiple times.

s2c.name: env
s2c.description: Sent once after session_id, while the session is still staged, including when the array is empty. Each entry is KEY=VALUE; split at the first equals sign because values may contain equals signs. This completes the initial environment snapshot but does not indicate that session resources exist.

s2c.name: done

description.summary: commit succeeded and session setup is complete

s2c.description: The leader has been placed in its session cgroup. The client may now release the leader to execute the session command.

s2c.name: failed
s2c.description: An operation can fail if the UID has no user account, the session leader is invalid or cannot be placed in the session cgroup, or the session cgroup cannot be created or monitored. Commit also fails if a delegated cgroup is empty. A failed commit consumes the staged session.

c2s.name: commit

description.summary: commit staged fields and create the session

c2s.description: Finalizes the staged configuration and creates the session, replying with done on success or failed on failure. Both leader and delegate_cgroup are optional. If neither is set, the PID from the client's peer credentials (ucreds) is used as the session leader. Sending both is a protocol error. When delegate_cgroup is set, the client must place the session leader PID in the delegated cgroup before committing. Commit consumes the staged session even on failure; retrying requires a new session object. No fields may be changed after commit, and committing an already-created session is a protocol error.

c2s.name: leader
c2s.description: Optional. Must be sent while staged. Supplies the process ID of the leader to place in the session cgroup when committed. PID 0 is invalid: the server sends an invalid_args error and destroys the staged session. Sending both leader and delegate_cgroup for the same session, in either order, is a protocol error.

arg.name: leader_pid
arg.summary: process ID of the session leader

c2s.name: delegate_cgroup
c2s.description: Optional. Must be sent while staged. Creates the session cgroup and returns a cgroup handle immediately. The client must place the session leader PID in the cgroup before committing. Sending both delegate_cgroup and leader for the same session, in either order, is a protocol error.

c2s.name: tty
c2s.description: Optional. Must be sent while staged

object.name: session_management_cgroup
object.description: Handle for the cgroup delegated to a staged session. The client may use the reported path to manage the cgroup directly.

s2c.name: path
s2c.description: Reports the absolute path of the delegated cgroup before the owning session is committed. The client may place the session leader PID in this cgroup through its cgroup.procs file.

value.name: already_committed
value.summary: request sent after the session was committed

value.name: leader_conflict
value.summary: leader PID and delegated cgroup were both selected

value.name: leader_already_set
value.summary: leader PID was selected more than once

value.name: cgroup_already_delegated
value.summary: delegated cgroup was requested more than once

value.name: session_not_pending
value.summary: request sent without a pending session transaction

value.name: user
value.summary: interactive login session owned by a user

value.name: greeter
value.summary: login prompt or display manager session

value.name: lock_screen
value.summary: screen locker session associated with an existing login

value.name: background
value.summary: non-interactive user session without an attached seat or VT

value.name: background_light
value.summary: lightweight background session excluded from idle shutdown accounting

value.name: manager_early
value.summary: early per-user service manager session created before a regular login

value.name: unkown
value.summary: session whose type could not be determined
